governance_basis.binding_semantics: This exact Git blob object is the governance basis for this workflow. Later edits to STANDING_PROTOCOL.md do not alter this workflow unless adopted through a successor authority revision.

canonicality.human_documents: non-authoritative generated or navigational views only; they may add no operative requirement
canonicality.representation_rule: Any human rendering must be deterministically generated from this authority and bind its exact SHA-256. A rendering mismatch blocks authority freeze but cannot alter authority semantics.
canonicality.immutability_rule: Reviewed authority bytes are immutable. Frozen standing is created only by a separate create-last authority-freeze artifact. Any byte change creates a successor authority requiring fresh review.

lineage.history_rule: All prior candidates, reviews, qualifications, failures, and unavailable checks are append-only history and may not be rewritten or deleted.

problem.title: Construct a 13-channel sorting network with at most 44 comparators
problem.comparator_semantics: For [i,j] with 0 <= i < j <= 12, replace channel i with min(old_i,old_j) and channel j with max(old_i,old_j).
problem.network_semantics: One fixed ordered comparator sequence is applied identically to every input; hidden preprocessing, adaptive comparator choice, mutable cross-input state, and variable-length execution are forbidden.
problem.zero_one_principle: A fixed comparator network sorts arbitrary totally ordered inputs iff it sorts every Boolean input of the same channel count.

frontier_context.lower_bound_policy: No lower-bound value is required for or receives authority in this constructive workflow.

sources.name: Bert Dobbelaere — List of sorting networks
sources.observed_fact: row n=13 lists a 45-comparator 10-layer network and size interval 44...45

sources.name: Jannis Harder — An Answer to the Bose-Nelson Sorting Problem for 11 and 12 Channels
sources.observed_fact: published optimal-size results close n=11 and n=12, not n=13

frontier_context.standing_role: context only; external frontier movement never invalidates a mathematical witness
frontier_context.reporting_rule: Before any public novelty statement, perform a fresh external frontier check. WITNESS_FOUND_AND_VERIFIED never implies priority or novelty.

candidate.raw_search_output_rule: preserve raw search output separately; raw bytes have provenance standing only, never witness standing

canonical_encoding.comparator: JSON array of exactly two base-10 integer tokens [i,j]
canonical_encoding.integer_lexeme: digits only, no sign, no leading zero unless token is exactly 0
canonical_encoding.canonicalizer_limits: may serialize a valid parsed comparator list but may not reorder, reverse, add, delete, deduplicate, repair, or coerce values
canonical_encoding.identity: SHA-256 of exact canonical candidate bytes

local_verifier_predicates.LOCAL_SORT_PASS: This verifier independently establishes that the exact comparator sequence satisfies the sorted-output predicate for every Boolean input.
local_verifier_predicates.LOCAL_WITNESS_PASS: This verifier independently establishes canonical structure, comparator_count <=44, valid comparator indices, and LOCAL_SORT_PASS. It is computed without reading or trusting the other verifier's output.

aggregate_gate_predicate.WITNESS_GATE_PASS: A separate gate, not either verifier, independently authenticates the frozen authority; exact candidate identity; standing qualification for both verifier sources; both LOCAL_WITNESS_PASS evidence records bound to the same candidate and authority; standing outside-derivation review; fresh candidate-chain hostile review; and independent replay. Missing, stale, mismatched, or indeterminate input fails closed.

decision_model.no_caller_authority: No caller-provided boolean, hash, mode, prior disposition, or claimed verifier result may substitute for reconstruction from repository artifacts.

deletion_mutants.construction: mutant k removes comparator k from the exact baseline, for k=0..44
deletion_mutants.escalation_rule: If any deletion mutant passes any qualified verifier's sorting predicate, freeze it as a <=44 candidate and route it to the witness gate; do not normalize it away as a fixture.

a.required_core: enumerate exactly every integer 0..8191 once, construct a fresh 13-element Boolean vector for each input, apply comparators in order, and test the explicit sorted-output predicate
a.coverage_evidence: record cardinality 8192 and an exact coverage-set digest or equivalent proof that no input was omitted/duplicated
a.failure_evidence: retain at least one exact counterexample input/output for FAIL

required_core_options: bit-parallel propagation of all Boolean vectors in a representation not used by verifier A
SAT/SMT search for existence of an unsorted Boolean input
prohibitions: do not import verifier A decision code
do not consume verifier A verdict
do not share verifier A mutable state or coverage accumulator
b.cross_language: use a second standard runtime/language if available; availability or unavailability must be recorded as qualification evidence, not asserted in prose

parser_rules.accept_only: canonical candidate bytes for witness verification; control fixtures are loaded from frozen fixture artifacts under their declared expected control length

differential_faults: comparator min/max orientation reversed in one verifier
comparator channel index remapped/off-by-one in one verifier
one comparator skipped in one verifier
one Boolean input omitted by verifier A coverage loop
one Boolean input duplicated while another is omitted by verifier A coverage loop
cross-input state intentionally carried in verifier A
parser accepts boolean-as-integer in one verifier
candidate comparator sequence mutated after identity hash in one verifier path
verifiers.fault_rule: Each injected defect must be detected by a declared guard, the other independent verifier, or both. Do not require verdict change for transformations that merely permute the complete Boolean input set.

authority_review.acceptance: zero unresolved CRITICAL and zero unresolved HIGH

verifier_qualification.pass_condition: every required control has its frozen expected result and every injected guard is demonstrated non-vacuous

verifier_review.acceptance: zero unresolved CRITICAL and zero unresolved HIGH

outside_derivation_review.standing_rule: PASS is required before candidate standing. UNAVAILABLE is preserved and blocks WITNESS_GATE_PASS; it may not be silently substituted.

search_budget.immutability: any budget expansion is a successor search pass

candidate_chain_review.acceptance: zero unresolved CRITICAL and zero unresolved HIGH

phases.name: authority qualification and freeze
phases.gate: accepted authority review + frontier evidence snapshot + create-last authority freeze

phases.name: fresh hostile verifier review
phases.gate: verifier review has zero unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH

phases.name: bounded constructive search
phases.entry: standing verifier review + immutable search budget
phases.gate: standing witness candidate or budget exhaustion or method defect

phases.name: candidate/result gate
phases.gate: closed final disposition reconstructed from standing artifacts

search.diagnostic_path: may target the 45-comparator control under separately labeled diagnostic budget; diagnostic success grants no witness standing
candidate_handling: hash canonical bytes before verifier execution
any verifier disagreement blocks candidate standing and triggers investigation
search.failure_semantics: budget exhaustion, timeout, solver UNKNOWN, heuristic failure, or no candidate found never implies nonexistence or a lower bound

requirements: independent replay from frozen canonical candidate
WITNESS_FOUND_AND_VERIFIED.meaning: A standing witness establishes S(13) <= candidate_length only.

SEARCH_EXHAUSTED_WITHOUT_RESOLUTION.meaning: No standing <=44 witness was found in this bounded search; the mathematical problem remains unresolved.

result_gate.METHOD_NEEDS_REPAIR: Authority is frozen/coherent but downstream machinery has repairable defects.
result_gate.AUTHORITY_REVISION_REQUIRED: A frozen authority defect requires a successor authority.
result_gate.METHOD_NOT_VIABLE: The approach cannot be made trustworthy within the frozen constraints.

standing_and_invalidation.authority_revision: revokes all downstream standing under prior authority for successor work; historical artifacts remain valid for their historical authority/source
standing_and_invalidation.verifier_source_change: stales its qualification, dependent candidate verification, verifier review if bound to changed evidence, and final witness disposition
standing_and_invalidation.search_source_change: stales only affected search diagnostics/performance and provenance; verifier standing is unchanged unless dependency is explicit
standing_and_invalidation.evidence_regeneration: stales reviews bound to prior evidence summary
standing_and_invalidation.frontier_movement: affects novelty context only, not mathematical witness validity
standing_and_invalidation.repair_rule: compute minimal restoration closure in dependency order; do not rerun unrelated work merely because HEAD advanced
standing_and_invalidation.final_confirmation: before final disposition, independently reconstruct every required standing binding at the evidence-bearing HEAD

durability.remote_identity_rule: verify the durable branch contains each intended artifact before claiming the corresponding gate complete
durability.history_rule: no force-push, amend-away, squash-away, or deletion of failed governed lineage

prohibitions: No verifier implementation before Phase A gate.
No search before Phase C gate and immutable search budget.
No nonexistence or lower-bound claim in this workflow.
No mutation of reviewed canonical authority bytes.
No adaptive acceptance, verifier, review-severity, or budget rules after seeing promising candidate behavior.
No self-certification by searcher, generator, verifier, or LLM.
No deletion or rewriting of failed governed artifacts.
